title: narcissus assoanus subsp. baeticus
intro: Narcissus assoanus subsp. baeticus, commonly known as Narcissus baeticus, is a subspecies of the Narcissus assoanus plant, belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, particularly in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Narcissus baeticus include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities, which may aid in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include alkaloids, particularly galanthamine, which has been reported to have neuroprotective and anticholinesterase activities.
